issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

cert.description: A cached instance of native java X509Certificate class.

content.description:
The string representation of the X509 certificate in PEM extension. The certificate could either be constructed with
this content field populated or sourcing from the specified the {@link fileUrl} pointing to the certificate file
in PEM extension.

fileUrl.description:
The url of the file storing the certificate in PEM extension on a Cloud FileSystem (ex: {@link S3 Se} or
{@link AzureFileSystem AzureFileSystem}). The url should contains scheme (i.e. file-system)
and fully qualified encoded path.

title:
X509Certificate is a digital certificate that uses the widely accepted international X.509 public key infrastructure (PKI)
standard to verify that a public key belongs to the user, computer or service identity contained within the certificate
name: X509Certificate
